framework: OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks

tests.name: Horizontal IDOR Verification
tests.technique: Substitute User A's ID with User B's ID in URL path, query params, or JSON body.
tests.fail_condition: Status 200 with User B confidential data returned

tests.name: Vertical Privilege Escalation
tests.technique: Access administrative routes with standard user credentials.

tests.name: Method Tampering Bypass
tests.technique: Swap GET/POST with PUT, DELETE, or HEAD to bypass endpoint middleware filters.
tests.pass_condition: Status 405 Method Not Allowed or 403 Forbidden

tests.name: Sensitive Data in Transit / Query Parameters
tests.technique: Verify passwords, API tokens, or session IDs are not transmitted in GET URL query strings.
tests.pass_condition: All authentication parameters delivered via secure POST/PUT JSON payload with HTTPS
tests.fail_condition: API tokens visible in URL query string logged by proxies and browser history

tests.name: Weak / Static Secret Signatures
tests.technique: Test JWT against standard dictionary of weak HMAC secrets (jwt-cracker, hashcat).
tests.pass_condition: Secret exceeds 256 bits of entropy and cannot be forged
tests.fail_condition: Token forged with secret like 'secret', 'password', or app name

tests.name: SQL Injection (Boolean / Error / Time-based)
tests.technique: Inject single quote, comment sequences, or SLEEP/WAITFOR statements.
tests.pass_condition: Query executes within regular network baseline time (<1s)
tests.fail_condition: Response consistently delayed by exactly 5+ seconds across multiple tests

tests.name: OS Command Injection
tests.technique: Inject separators (; | & %0a `) followed by sleep or ping.
tests.pass_condition: Input validation rejects special characters or treats input strictly as literal argument
tests.fail_condition: Execution delayed by 5 seconds or shell output reflected

tests.name: CORS Overly Permissive Origin with Credentials
tests.technique: Send Origin: https://evil.com and inspect response headers.
tests.pass_condition: Origin is not reflected, or Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is not true

tests.name: Exposed Debugging & Framework Actuators
tests.technique: Enumerate common diagnostic paths (Spring Boot, Django, Flask, Express).
tests.fail_condition: Status 200 revealing system environment variables and configuration secrets

tests.name: Password Reset Poisoning via Host Header
tests.technique: Send password reset request with modified Host / X-Forwarded-Host header.
tests.pass_condition: Email link generated using strictly configured server base URL
tests.fail_condition: Reset link delivered to victim points to https://attacker.com/reset?token=xyz

tests.name: Missing Rate Limiting on Authentication Endpoints
tests.technique: Send burst of 30 rapid authentication requests.
tests.pass_condition: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests or CAPTCHA enforced after 5-10 attempts
tests.fail_condition: All 30 requests process without throttle or lockout

tests.name: Cloud Metadata Exfiltration
tests.technique: Supply cloud metadata URLs into image fetchers, webhook registers, or PDF generators.
tests.pass_condition: Request blocked by RFC 1918 / link-local egress firewall rules
tests.fail_condition: Response body or generated PDF renders AWS/cloud metadata structure
